The '''''Maelstrom''-class battle cruiser''' was a heavily-armed and expensive [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Command ship/Legends|command ship]] in use during the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Characteristics==
The ''Maelstrom''-class [[Battlecruiser/Legends|battle cruisers]] were deployed by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] as [[Command ship/Legends|command ships]]. It was heavily armed and carried numerous combat vehicles.<ref name="LbE" />

It had a long and thin delta-shaped hull and double command [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|bridges]] perched over the stern. Each ship cost 158 million credits.<ref name="LbE" />

{{Ship-stub}}

==History==
The [[Maelstrom (Maelstrom-class)/Legends|''Maelstrom'']] was deployed during the [[Battle of Cularin/Legends|campaign]] in the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]]. It was lost saving the system from a [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]].<ref name="Living Force" />

Due to its staggering cost, most of the class never saw action. Following the [[Declaration of a New Order]], the surviving ships were mothballed or used as technology test beds. The [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] was able to use one war-torn vessel, the [[Simoom/Legends|''Simoom'']].<ref name="LbE" />

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Maelstrom'' appears in [[Wizards of the Coast]]'s [[Living Force (roleplaying campaign)|''Living Force'']] [[roleplaying game]] campaign. The class was expanded upon in the later sourcebook ''[[Lead by Example]]'', published by [[Fantasy Flight Games]].
